{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers
loyal_df = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted = 1 among loyal customers
conversion_rate = loyal_df['converted'].mean()

# Also compute the count of loyal customers and converted loyal customers
n_loyal = len(loyal_df)
n_converted_loyal = loyal_df['converted'].sum()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of loyal customers: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal customers: {n_converted_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate}")"}
